# 21st Century Quality Home Care

> Non-medical home care for seniors, veterans, and families in the Houston, Texas area. Based in Arcola, TX. Phone 832-367-9087. Texas license #021589.

## Services
- [Personal Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/personal-care/): Hands-on help with bathing, dressing, and daily routines.
- [Companion Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/companion-care-service/): Company, conversation, and a steady presence at home.
- [Respite Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/respite-care-services/): A break for the family member who does the caregiving.
- [Light Housekeeping](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/light-housekeeping-services/): Laundry, tidying, and meals so the home stays livable.
- [Bath and Grooming Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/total-bath-and-grooming-care/): Safe, dignified help with bathing and grooming.
- [Sunrise and Sunset Visits](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/rise-and-shine-sunset-services/): Help getting the day started and settling in at night.
- [Specialized Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/specialized-services/): Support for Alzheimer’s, dementia, ALS, and MS.
- [End-of-Life Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/end-of-life-care-services/): Comfort and presence for your loved one and your family.
- [Private Duty Home Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/private-duty-home-care/): One-to-one care on the schedule your family needs.
- [In-Home Care Services](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/in-home-care-services/): Ongoing non-medical care in the comfort of home.
- [At-Home Wellness and Spa](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/at-home-wellness-spa-services/): Relaxation and wellness services brought to the home.
- [Pet Care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/petcare/): Help caring for the pets your loved one depends on.

## Paying for care
- [Veterans home care](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/veterans-home-care/): VA programs such as Aid and Attendance can help eligible veterans and surviving spouses pay for home care.
- [Long-term care insurance](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/long-term-care-insurance/): We work with policies from Genworth, John Hancock, MassMutual, Mutual of Omaha, New York Life, Northwestern Mutual, Physicians Mutual, LifeSecure, Bankers Life, Thrivent, Transamerica, Lincoln MoneyGuard, Nationwide CareMatters.
- [Medicare GUIDE program](https://21stcenturyqhc.com/medicare-guide-dementia-care/): People living with dementia or Alzheimer's who have traditional Medicare Part A and Part B may get up to 70 hours of in-home care.
